request.text: What is the total operational carbon for the building?

reply.text: 37,196.2 kgCO2e/yr. The graph sums OperationalCarbon_kgCO2e_per_year over all 218 elements of nrc_analytics_elements.csv.

request.text: Which storey has the higher mean energy intensity, Level 1 or Level 2?

reply.text: Level 2, at a mean of 40.56 kWh/m²/yr over 93 elements, against Level 1's 40.50 over 103. The gap, 0.06, is smaller than the one-decimal rounding of the source values, so treat the two as level.

request.text: Which five elements have the highest operational carbon?

reply.text: All five are in the Wall category. The highest is Basic Wall:Interior - Partition (92mm Stud):190140 at 412.0 kgCO2e/yr, then 410.8, 402.0, 399.7, and 398.6. The third is an upper cabinet that the dataset files under Wall.

request.text: What is the operational carbon of the door with GlobalId 1hOSvn6df7F8_7GcBWlS8Z?

reply.text: 54.0 kgCO2e/yr. The table has one row, the door M_Single-Flush:0762 x 2032mm:0762 x 2032mm:150173 (EntityId 8066). A GlobalId names one instance, so the answer is that door's own value and not the type's.

request.text: How much operational carbon is stored per IFC class?

reply.text: Fourteen IFC classes, highest first. IFCWALLSTANDARDCASE carries the most, 17,547.4 kgCO2e/yr, then IFCSLAB at 5,816.9 and IFCFURNISHINGELEMENT at 5,766.3; IFCRAILING carries the least, 164.8. The file has no Category property, so the question is answered per IFC class, and the chart draws the 14 totals as bars.

request.text: Which analysis run produced these values, and when?

reply.text: Every one of the 218 elements cites run run-2026-09-17-01, scenario Baseline. The run file, nrc-run.csv, says when and how: ComputedAt 2026-09-17T00:00:00Z, by the script generate_synthetic_analytics.py.

request.text: Which analysed elements carry no embodied-carbon property set?

reply.text: One element: the IfcRoof 0jf0rYHfX3RAB3bSIRjmxl. It has no embodied-carbon row in the analytics (it has two other metric rows), so the graph returns it as a row of its own. That absence is the answer; no value is inferred from its neighbours or its name.

request.text: What is the total embodied carbon (A1-A3) per storey?

reply.text: Level 1 49,451.2, Level 2 48,696.8, T/FDN 11,761.3, and Roof 5,821.0 kgCO2e. The table also carries each storey's element count, how many of those elements have a value, and the mean energy intensity. On Roof only 7 of 8 do: the roof itself has none (Q7), so Roof's total covers seven elements.

request.text: Chart embodied and operational carbon per storey.

reply.text: One pair of bars for each of the four storeys, embodied A1-A3 beside operational. The building totals are not a fifth pair of bars: they are the one row of the second table, 218 elements, 115,730.3 kgCO2e embodied and 37,196.2 kgCO2e/yr operational. The operational total is turn 1's answer.
